crew_quarters.description: Your small bunk room with a metal frame bed and a flickering light.

objects.description: Your toolbag, but it's missing your tools.
Your dirty shirt is laying on your rack.

hallway.description: A long corridor with metal walls. You hear a faint hissing sound coming from deeper in the ship.

galley.description: The ships kitchen, filled with the scent of coffee and last night's meal.

objects.description: The Captain's coffee mug with fresh hot coffee.
A cold pot of leftover chicken tortilla soup.
Unusually small pliers on the countertop.

crew_lounge.description: A relaxaing area for the crew with worn out chairs and a small table.

objects.description: A weathered deck of playing cards.
Strong waterproof tape for temporary pipe fixes.
A navy medal was left on the side of a chair.

machinery_room.description: The Machinery Technicians workspace, cluttered with tools and blueprints.

objects.description: A half empty box of screws.

storeroom.description: A storage room filled with documents, snacks, and some spare tools.

objects.description: A set of pliers for gripping and cutting.
You seem some delicious peanut butter.
You see some boxes of old military files.

engine_room.description: A dimly lit room filled with the hum of machinery. A large pipe is hissing steam. The door is locked.

objects.description: A pipe with a slow but steady leak. Needs fixing.
Pair of old dirty worn boots is on the floor.
You see the captain's journal. Interesting.
